pictures.label: Face / Identity
pictures.tooltip: Strongest facial identity reference: face shape, eyes, nose, mouth, skin, proportions. Authority for close-ups and facial performance. Not wardrobe, product, background, style or lighting.

pictures.label: Character Sheet
pictures.tooltip: Full character/body reference: proportions, silhouette, height/build, front/side/back. Together with Face they form one identity system (same character).

pictures.label: Wardrobe
pictures.tooltip: Clothing, garments, fabric/materials, outfit colors, shoes, accessories only. Not a character identity source — wins over incidental clothing visible in Face/Character Sheet.

pictures.label: Product / Hero Object
pictures.tooltip: The exact hero commercial product or object: shape, proportions, materials, packaging, branding. Usually highest priority for ads.

pictures.label: Visual Style
pictures.tooltip: Art direction, aesthetic treatment, palette tendency, texture, production-design mood, rendering language. Not the literal background.

pictures.label: Lighting / Grade
pictures.tooltip: Global scene lighting + color grade authority: light direction, key/fill, shadows, white balance, contrast, saturation, final grade. Not the physical background/location.

pictures.label: Background / Environment
pictures.tooltip: The actual physical environment: room, landscape, architecture, set, location, spatial layout. Supplies the place; Lighting supplies the light.

pictures.label: Extra Reference 1
pictures.tooltip: No fixed role. Only use if you explain its purpose in the prompt (logo, packaging detail, prop, secondary angle, etc.).

pictures.label: Extra Reference 2
pictures.tooltip: No fixed role. Same as Extra 1 — only use with an explicit assigned purpose.

videos.label: Motion Guide
videos.tooltip: Body motion, gesture, performance timing, choreography, action rhythm. Hard motion/performance authority when active. Does not carry identity, wardrobe, background or camera.

videos.label: Camera Guide
videos.tooltip: Camera trajectory, height, viewpoint, pan/tilt/dolly/orbit/crane, framing and shot-size progression, screen-space staging. Hard camera + composition authority when active. Can be built with the Camera Director below instead of uploading a file.

videos.label: Source / Edit Video
videos.tooltip: Existing video to edit/reinterpret. Always used with PRESERVE / CHANGE logic: preserve timing/composition/blocking, change only what other active references override.

audios.label: Audio 1 — Primary
audios.tooltip: Primary external voice/music/rhythm reference. Its exact job (voice timbre, delivery, music, singing) depends on what you describe in the prompt.

audios.label: Audio 2 — Optional
audios.tooltip: Optional second external audio reference. Only used when you give it an explicit role (second voice, ambience, secondary music cue).

notes.source_video_audio: When Source Video (Video 3) is active and neither Audio 1 nor Audio 2 is active, its own paired soundtrack is preserved automatically for the final output. This is handled by the workflow's audio-priority routing, not a separate reference slot.
notes.zero_tolerance_rule: Never mention a <Picture N>/<Video N>/<Audio N> tag in the prompt for a slot that is not enabled — the semantic node rejects prompts that reference inactive slots.
